caption: The drawing features a single rectangular, block-like object positioned centrally on a plain, light beige background. The object appears solid and three-dimensional, rendered in varying shades of gray and light brown, suggesting a stone or concrete texture. The top surface of the rectangular block has four evenly spaced, small circular indentations arranged in a line. The sides of the block are shaded to indicate depth and angle, with darker shadows beneath and on one side giving it a sense of mass and dimension. There are no other objects or elements present in the composition, and the background remains uniformly empty apart from the centrally placed block.
title: Silver Snuff Box
